{{Top|leg}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] held a '''tracking station''' on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Picutorion/Legends|Picutorion]]. During the [[raid on Picutorion]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces from the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Tensiger]]'s [[6th regiment]] penetrated the station.
